load-failed: Error on Operations → Cost when the list of model prices could not be read.
per-million: A model's price per million tokens, as in a table cell: {{price}} is an amount in US dollars ("$0.15"). "M" stands for million; keep it short.
stats.label: Accessible name of the row of tiles at the top of Operations → Cost.
stats.cost: Tile: what turns cost over the range. "Turns" are answers from a socio (an AI agent).
stats.priced: Tile: how many turns had a price (or a cost pool) to cost them.
stats.priced-of: Note under the Priced turns tile: out of how many turns in total.
stats.unpriced: Tile: how many turns ran on a model Socio has no price for.
stats.unpriced-note: Note under the Turns without a price tile; lowercase, no final period.
stats.idle: Tile: what self-hosted backends cost in hours when no turn ran on them.
stats.idle-note: Note under the Idle capacity tile; lowercase, no final period. "Cost pools": an admin's running costs of a self-hosted backend or a subscription.
change.new: Note under the Cost tile when the period before cost nothing and this one did; lowercase.
change.same: Note under the Cost tile when both periods cost nothing; lowercase.
change.percent: Note under the Cost tile: {{change}} is the change against the period before, as a signed percentage ("+12%").
chart.description: Under the cost chart's title. {{bucket}} is one of chart.x's words (hour, day, week, month): what one bar of the chart covers.
chart.x: The unit one bar of the cost chart covers, lowercase; also the chart's x-axis name. The base form is used before the numbers load.
empty.none: In an empty table or card when the analytics store has no numbers yet.
empty.no-turns: In an empty table when no turns ran in the chosen range.
columns.model: Each columns.*: a column heading in the Cost page's tables.
columns.socio: "Socio": a product noun, an AI agent of the workspace.
columns.paid-by: Column heading: whose model subscription paid for the turns.
columns.room: "Room": a product noun, a shared chat with people and socios.
columns.cycles: Work cycles: one person's message and every step it led to.
columns.self-hosted: Column heading: a self-hosted backend's cost per million tokens, from its cost pools.
columns.cloud-price: Column heading: what the cheapest listed cloud provider would charge per million tokens for the same turns.
unpriced: A badge or small note in a table row: how many of the row's turns had no price.
not-recorded: A table row or backend whose name the turns didn't record.
by-socio.title: Card title: cost per socio (an AI agent).
payers.workspace: Row in Who paid: the workspace's own models paid.
payers.person: Row in Who paid for a person whose name isn't known.
cycles.cycles-value: {{cycles}} work cycles in total, {{rooms}} of them in Rooms.
cycles.steps-value: {{steps}} steps in total; {{handoffs}} of them handed the work on to another socio.
cycles.deadline: How many work cycles a limit stopped; each of these lines names the limit.
cycles.running: Total time the cycles' steps ran, waits left out.
cycles.wall: Total time from each cycle's start to its end.
rooms.unnamed: A Room whose name isn't known.
rooms.people: Under a Room's name: how many people took part.
rooms.socios: Under a Room's name: how many socios (AI agents) took part.
rooms.hit-limit: Under a Room's cycle count: how many cycles a limit stopped.
rooms.handed-on: Under a Room's turn count: how many turns handed the work on to another socio.
backends.description: "Backend": where a model runs (a provider's API, a self-hosted server).
backends.shared: A backend name for older turns that ran on a shared backend before backends were recorded one by one.
backends.connections: A backend name: people's own ChatGPT (or similar) connections; {{name}} is the provider's name.
backends.removed: A backend name for one that was removed; {{id}} is the start of its id.
unpriced-models.on: Beside a model's name: {{backend}} is the backend it ran on, then how many turns.
unpriced-models.add: Link-style button: opens the price form below, filled in for this model.
